firm_data.firm_description: Borchert & LaSpina, P.C. is a respected law firm based in Queens, New York providing personal service tailored to legal needs. The firm's attorneys practice in multiple areas of law, including real estate, mortgage foreclosure, commercial litigation, personal injury, and elder law.
notable_facts: The firm has over 100 years of combined trusted legal experience.
Borchert & LaSpina, P.C. has its origins in the 1940s.
The firm has an A.V. rating bestowed on it by Martingale-Hubbell Law Directory.

email.subject: AI for Borchert & LaSpina - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Gregory,

With over 100 years of combined legal experience across your team, Borchert & LaSpina has built something most firms never achieve: deep expertise and trusted relationships. That foundation makes you exactly the kind of firm that can compete harder when the right tools match your precision and client focus.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: accuracy, client trust, and real efficiency gains in real estate, foreclosure, and commercial litigation.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms in your market. I'd be happy to stop by your Whitestone office to share how we're helping similar practices compete.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
